आदेश — महाराष्ट्र सर्वसाधारण भविष्य निर्वाह निधी नियम, 1998, नियम-30, ठेव संलग्न विमा योजना यातील प्राप्त अधिकारान्वये, निम्नस्वाक्षरीकार दिवंगत श्री. मिलिंद रामचंद्र गवळे, बेलिफ, अपर जिल्हा व सत्र न्यायालय, अहमदपूर यांच्या नामनिर्देशिती श्रीमती संध्या मिलिंद गवळे, पत्नी (100%) यांना वरील अ.क्र. 2 च्या पत्रात नमूद ठेव संलग्न विमा योजनेखाली रु. 60,000/- (रुपये साठ हजार फक्त) इतकी रक्कम मंजूर करीत आहेत.

सदर रक्कम वित्तीय वर्ष 2026-27 मध्ये मागणी क्र. जे-2, 2235-सामाजिक सुरक्षा व कल्याण, 60-इतर सामाजिक सुरक्षा व कल्याण कार्यक्रम, 104-ठेव संलग्न विमा योजना, शासकीय भविष्य निर्वाह निधी, (00)(02) ठेव संलग्न विमा योजनेपोटी प्रदान, 50-इतर खर्च (22350623) (दत्तमत) या लेखाशीर्षाखाली खर्ची टाकावी.

दिवंगत श्री. मिलिंद रामचंद्र गवळे, बेलिफ, अपर जिल्हा व सत्र न्यायालय, अहमदपूर यांचे खाते AJBN/12888 होते; रु. 60,000/- (रुपये साठ हजार फक्त) ही रक्कम नामनिर्देशिती श्रीमती संध्या मिलिंद गवळे, पत्नी (100%) यांना अदा करावी.

blocks.para: महाराष्ट्र सर्वसाधारण भविष्य निर्वाह निधी नियम, 1998, नियम 30 (1) : 30. Deposit Linked Insurance Scheme.–On the death of a subscriber, the person entitled to receive the amount standing to the credit of the subscriber shall be authorised by the Account Officer, an additional amount equal to the average balance in the account during the three years immediately preceding the death of such subscriber subject to the following conditions that.– (a) the balance to the credit of such subscriber shall not at any time during the three years preceding the month of death have fallen below the limits of :– (i) Rs. 25,000 in case of subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-2 (Rs. 9,300-34,800) or above and drawing a Grade-pay of Rs. 4,800 or more as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2009 ; (ii) Rs. 15,000 in the case of a subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-2 (Rs. 9,300-34,800) and drawing a Grade pay of Rs. 4,200 or more but less than Rs. 4,800 as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised pay) Rules, 2009 ; (iii) Rs. 10,000 in the case of a subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-2, Pay Band-1 or Pay Band-1S (Rs. 4,440-7,440) and drawing a Grade-pay of Rs. 1,400 or more but less than Rs. 4,200 as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2009 ; (iv) Rs. 6,000 in the case of a subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-1S (Rs. 4,440-7,440) and drawing a Grade pay of Rs. 1,300 or more but less than Rs. 1,400 as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2009. (b) the additional amount payable under this rule shall not exceed Rs. 60,000. (c) The subscriber has put in at least five years service at the time of death. — स्रोत : The Maharashtra General Provident Fund Rules (Corrected upto 14 February, 2017), पृ. 23-24; खंड (a), (b) G.N. GAD दि. 19.12.2015, Rule 9(I) अन्वये प्रतिस्थापित. फाइल : pdf/59-gpf-rules-1998-key-provisions/MGPF_Rules1.pdf (पृ. 48, 50). स्थिती : मूळ वाचले (पॅकेज PDF पृ. 13-14)

महाराष्ट्र सर्वसाधारण भविष्य निर्वाह निधी नियम, 1998, नियम 30 (2), (3) व टीप 7 : (2) The Head of Office, under whom the Government servant was serving at the time of his death, shall make payments of the amount admissible under sub-rule (1) after ascertaining the admissibility of the amount from the Accounts Officer (Head of office in case of class IV employees) and the Head of Department in respect of budget grants. (3) Where a subscriber has held the post in different scales during the 36 months immediately preceding the month of his death, the appropriate minimum qualifying balance in respect of such scale, a deceased subscriber shall be the one relating to the scale in which he held the post for the greater part of the last three years. Note 7.–The budget estimates of expenditure in respect of this scheme shall be prepared by the respective Heads of Departments having regard to the trend of expenditure. — स्रोत : नियमपुस्तिका पृ. 24. स्थिती : मूळ वाचले (पॅकेज PDF पृ. 14)

(3) पृ.6/प.वि. वरील पत्र महालेखाकार (लेखा व हकदारी)-2, नागपूर यांचे असून, त्यावर क्रमांक FD8/DLIS/FR2624037/ व त्यापुढे हस्तलिखित 107 आणि दिनांक 07.04.2026 असा टंकलिखित व त्याखाली हस्तलिखित 08-04-26 असे नमूद आहे. पृ.11/प.वि. वरील आदेशात सदर क्रमांक व दि. 08.04.2026 रोजीचे पत्र प्रधान महालेखाकार (लेखा व हकदारी)-1 यांचे असा उल्लेख आहे.
7. उपरोक्त प्रस्तावाच्या अनुषंगाने खालीलप्रमाणे नमूद करण्यात येत आहे:-

(1) महाराष्ट्र सर्वसाधारण भविष्य निर्वाह निधी नियम, 1998 च्या नियम 30 (1) मध्ये असे नमूद करण्यात आले आहे की (पृ.13-14/प.वि.), “On the death of a subscriber, the person entitled to receive the amount standing to the credit of the subscriber shall be authorised by the Account Officer, an additional amount equal to the average balance in the account during the three years immediately preceding the death of such subscriber subject to the following conditions that.– (a) the balance to the credit of such subscriber shall not at any time during the three years preceding the month of death have fallen below the limits of :– (i) Rs. 25,000 in case of subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-2 (Rs. 9,300-34,800) or above and drawing a Grade-pay of Rs. 4,800 or more as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2009 ; (ii) Rs. 15,000 in the case of a subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-2 (Rs. 9,300-34,800) and drawing a Grade pay of Rs. 4,200 or more but less than Rs. 4,800 as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised pay) Rules, 2009 ; (iii) Rs. 10,000 in the case of a subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-2, Pay Band-1 or Pay Band-1S (Rs. 4,440-7,440) and drawing a Grade-pay of Rs. 1,400 or more but less than Rs. 4,200 as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2009 ; (iv) Rs. 6,000 in the case of a subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-1S (Rs. 4,440-7,440) and drawing a Grade pay of Rs. 1,300 or more but less than Rs. 1,400 as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2009. (b) the additional amount payable under this rule shall not exceed Rs. 60,000. (c) The subscriber has put in at least five years service at the time of death.”
(2) वरील नियम 30 (1) नुसार मृत्यूच्या लगतपूर्वीच्या तीन वर्षांतील सरासरी शिल्लकीएवढी अतिरिक्त रक्कम देय आहे. परंतु, सदर प्रकरणात सरासरी शिल्लक रु.44,981 असून, मंजूर रक्कम रु.60,000 आहे.

(3) वरील नियम 30 (1) (a) नुसार मृत्यूपूर्वीच्या तीन वर्षांत खाती जमा शिल्लक वेतनबँड व ग्रेड वेतननिहाय विहित मर्यादेपेक्षा कमी नसावी. परंतु, सदर प्रकरणात महालेखाकार यांनी न्यूनतम शिल्लक रु.(-)25,656 कळविली आहे.
(4) वरील नियम 30 (1) (b) नुसार अतिरिक्त रक्कम रु.60,000 पेक्षा अधिक नसावी. सदर प्रकरणात मंजूर रक्कम रु.60,000 आहे.
(5) वरील नियम 30 (1) (c) नुसार मृत्यूच्या वेळी किमान पाच वर्षांची सेवा झालेली असावी. सदर प्रकरणात कै. मि. रा. गवळे यांची 22 वर्षे सेवा झाली होती.

(6) नियम 30 (2) मध्ये असे नमूद करण्यात आले आहे की, “The Head of Office, under whom the Government servant was serving at the time of his death, shall make payments of the amount admissible under sub-rule (1) after ascertaining the admissibility of the amount from the Accounts Officer (Head of office in case of class IV employees) and the Head of Department in respect of budget grants.”

(7) नियम 30 (3) मध्ये असे नमूद करण्यात आले आहे की, “Where a subscriber has held the post in different scales during the 36 months immediately preceding the month of his death, the appropriate minimum qualifying balance in respect of such scale, a deceased subscriber shall be the one relating to the scale in which he held the post for the greater part of the last three years.”

(8) नियम 30 च्या टीप 7 मध्ये असे नमूद करण्यात आले आहे की, “The budget estimates of expenditure in respect of this scheme shall be prepared by the respective Heads of Departments having regard to the trend of expenditure.”

8. सदर प्रकरणी मा. प्रमुख जिल्हा व सत्र न्यायाधीश, लातूर यांच्या दि. 20.05.2026 रोजीच्या प्रस्तावाचे अवलोकन केले असता, त्यामध्ये खालील माहिती आढळून येत नाही:- (1) कै. मि. रा. गवळे यांनी मृत्यूपूर्वीच्या 36 महिन्यांत धारण केलेल्या पदाचे पदनाम, वेतनबँड, ग्रेड वेतन व कालावधी; (2) महालेखाकार यांनी न्यूनतम शिल्लक रु.(-)25,656 व सरासरी शिल्लक रु.44,981 कळविली असताना नियम 30 (1) अन्वये रु.60,000/- मंजूर करण्याचा आधार.

9. उपरोक्त वस्तुस्थिती विचारात घेता, महालेखाकार यांनी सरासरी शिल्लक रु.44,981 कळविली असून, मा. प्रमुख जिल्हा व सत्र न्यायाधीश, लातूर यांनी रु.60,000/- मंजूर केले आहेत. सबब, उपरोक्त माहिती तक्त्याच्या स्वरूपात मा. प्रमुख जिल्हा व सत्र न्यायाधीश, लातूर यांनी शासनास कळविण्याबाबतच्या पत्राचे प्रारूप पृ.      /प.वि. वर मान्यतेस्तव सादर. मान्य झाल्यास पत्र निर्गमित करण्यात येईल.

30. Deposit Linked Insurance Scheme.–On the death of a subscriber, the person entitled to receive the amount standing to the credit of the subscriber shall be authorised by the Account Officer, an additional amount equal to the average balance in the account during the three years immediately preceding the death of such subscriber subject to the following conditions that.–
(a) the balance to the credit of such subscriber shall not at any time during the three years preceding the month of death have fallen below the limits of :–

(i) Rs. 25,000 in case of subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-2 (Rs. 9,300-34,800) or above and drawing a Grade-pay of Rs. 4,800 or more as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2009 ;

(ii) Rs. 15,000 in the case of a subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-2 (Rs. 9,300-34,800) and drawing a Grade pay of Rs. 4,200 or more but less than Rs. 4,800 as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised pay) Rules, 2009 ;

(iii) Rs. 10,000 in the case of a subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-2, Pay Band-1 or Pay Band-1S (Rs. 4,440-7,440) and drawing a Grade-pay of Rs. 1,400 or more but less than Rs. 4,200 as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2009 ;

(iv) Rs. 6,000 in the case of a subscriber holding a post in the Pay Band-1S (Rs. 4,440-7,440) and drawing a Grade pay of Rs. 1,300 or more but less than Rs. 1,400 as per the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2009.
(b) the additional amount payable under this rule shall not exceed Rs. 60,000.
